description:
Call BEFORE your agent signs or sends anything from a wallet. Decodes a transaction, EIP-712 typed data (Permit, Permit2, EIP-3009 USDC authorizations, Seaport orders), an EIP-7702 delegation or an x402 payment (402 terms + payload) into plain English and returns SAFE / CAUTION / DANGER with risk flags (unlimited approvals, setApprovalForAll, fake USDC domains, x402 overpay or wrong payTo, OFAC SDN counterparties). Free preview tier (offline); paid check adds on-chain facts and an eth_call simulation.
Not for: token due diligence (use check_token) or address screening alone (use screen_address).

[SignCheck via YourAITools MCP Hub] Free tier: same as SignCheck's own MCP server (call without payment and without tier). Paid: lite $0.005 / check $0.015 per call, with a credits key (Authorization: Bearer yatc_...) or x402 (USDC; the hub returns the payment terms). Failed tool calls aren't charged: credits are refunded automatically and x402 payments only settle on success.

chain.description: base (default), ethereum, base-sepolia or a chain id

anyOf.description: The x402 payment payload the agent is about to send.

payment_payload.description: x402 payment you are about to send: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE / X-PAYMENT (base64) or JSON

anyOf.description: The x402 402 response body or decoded PAYMENT-REQUIRED header.

payment_required.description: x402 402 terms: the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (base64) or JSON {accepts:[…]}

tier.description: Paid tier: lite $0.005, check $0.015. Omit tier (with no credits key or x402 payment) to use the free tier.

typed_data.description: EIP-712 request {domain, types, primaryType, message} as passed to eth_signTypedData_v4
